verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms supabase.com/llms.txt is live (HTTP 200) and links to a single-file llms-full.txt. The llms.txt itself adds per-language reference corpora (js, dart, swift, kotlin, python, csharp, cli, api) and an explicit 'API and agent resources' section pointing to the OpenAPI spec and MCP endpoint. Beyond that, docs pages are served as .md, a machine-discoverable agent-skills index lives at /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json, and static prompt files plus a docs-search MCP tool give agents several more doc entry points; the only blemish, a 404 at /docs.md, is minor given that per-page .md docs are available.
